notes.title: With Eyes Closed and a quick dev update
notes.content:
Hey pervs, 

Today I would like to present to you a new project by Ker,

 With Eyes Closed, 

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/35065623/febe36a31751a5073820fc0edbb4b5d052967dc0.png

a thriller in the adult visual novel genre. It concentrates on storytelling, realistic characters, and letting players control the development of the story. The game also features plenty of hot scenes that are interwoven into the storyline.

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/35065623/3312155effbfba166905a0f77bd3eed396b472ec.gif

Please consider adding the game to your wishlists, it really helps. 

Regarding development updates, we have started on adding a new character to Match it Sexy, so our next update, in about 2-3 weeks will include a new date for one of the previous girls, plus new Match Animations, plus a new girl and her first date. 

New girl in Match it Sexy:

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/35065623/bee1b61d605bfa12b3ca6cf5b7f928446510a5f0.png

notes.title: Early Access transition
notes.content:
Hey everyone, 

Today we have pushed the final update on Endless Fucker, marking it's transition from Early Access to Completed. 
This update brings: 

 A new level: Rainbow

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114765/ffc7e154f1a82da0d9246b922426781a689851e0.png


 

 4 new girls to collect and find through the Rainbow world
 5 new animations to find and collect through the Rainbow world
 First Person view for more immersion (press "Q" to toggle in-and-out)
 New Record System
 Abilities improvement
 General fixes and quality of life improvements. 


New girls:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114765/54a6d6838c4e79c717321c1494457fc1aacfa874.png

First Person View:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114765/f112beaa358a6ddaa4856547b297a565e78645af.png


We thank you for your support during the development of the game and the feedback that you provided. 

We plan to add more content to the game in the coming months, so this is not the end of Endless Fucker development, just the next step.

notes.title: Power Up Update
notes.content:
Hey, 

First off, let us say sorry for not releasing an update faster. With the summer holiday, and other on-going projects, we got a bit delayed. We will try to do better for the next updates. 


Today's update brings you :

 6 new animations
 animations in harem take less space in the UI
 3 new powers 
 [olist]
  Super Jump (jump higher than a normal jump)
 Slow Motion (slow down time so you can take better decision)
 Hoola Hoop (go through matter while hoolahoping)
 [/olist]
 power are now evolutive, the faster you go, the more powerful they will be



The next update will focus on more animations and also more enviroments. 


Stay cool and see you soon!
